response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(GOT) AS og FROM Laboratory), per AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_got, p.avg_rbc, p.avg_got - o.og AS diff FROM per p JOIN overall o ON o.og IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Ties at the 10th place are broken arbitrarily, because the request gives no tie-break rule.
The overall GOT average is taken over all laboratory records (each row weighted equally), not the average of per-patient averages.
